description: The interchange at a place inside a module's forward: the query the attention hands its implementation, after the projection, the head reshape and RoPE, at layer 0 — read on the counterfactual prompt at its last token and swapped into the base prompt's. nnterp's `self_attn.attention_queries` reaches it through nnsight's `.source`, and serves it under eager attention only, which the model block says; the hooks engine refuses it by name. Only the logit difference is saved.
